jobs.title: AI Operations & Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
VMOMENT is a global leading technology company in Internet content creation, AI algorithm recommendation technology, AI large model technology, global AI big data asset trading platform, and global social cross-border e-commerce. The main team is composed of elites from world-renowned technology companies.

VMOMENT, a subsidiary of TIENS Group, is a global health vertical social e-commerce platform. It has established data centers and key operating bases in Singapore, Ireland, the United States, China and other locations. It supports translation into 85 languages, and its users cover 224 countries and regions worldwide. VMOMENT has established a global strategic cooperation platform with Huawei, Amazon, Tencent, Microsoft and others to jointly promote the global AI and cloud computing technology ecosystem.

Location:
Europe (Remote / Hybrid, based in Europe)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated VMoment AI Operations & Project Manager to drive the operational adoption, implementation, and delivery of AI-powered solutions across the European market.

This role serves as the key bridge between global headquarters and regional business teams, combining hands-on operational execution with structured project coordination — ensuring AI tools are effectively deployed, adopted, and translated into measurable business outcomes. The role is weighted primarily toward operational execution and implementation, while also owning project coordination and follow-up to keep AI initiatives on track.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence, project management discipline, training capabilities, business analysis skills, and a strong passion for AI-driven transformation. You will work closely with distributors, subsidiaries, and local teams to maximize AI utilization, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate business growth.

Tasks

Lead the rollout, implementation, and adoption of AI solutions across the European region.

Develop deployment plans and coordinate resources to ensure successful adoption by subsidiaries and distributors.

Support distributors and local teams in integrating AI tools into daily business operations.

Deliver training sessions, user guidance, and best practices to maximize adoption and business impact.

Act as the key liaison between headquarters, regional teams, distributors, and technical stakeholders.

Translate global AI initiatives into practical regional action plans and project deliverables.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business requirements from regional stakeholders, and translate them into actionable recommendations for Product and Technology teams.

Ensure smooth execution and follow-up of AI-related projects and operational activities, facilitating communication and aligning priorities across teams.

Track AI adoption, user engagement, and operational performance metrics, as well as project milestones, risks, and key deliverables.

Prepare regular status updates and project reviews; proactively resolve implementation challenges.

Analyze business feedback and identify opportunities to optimize processes, increase efficiency, and support business growth.

Work closely with Product, Technology, Sales, and Operations teams to communicate market needs, project status, and user feedback.

Contribute to the continuous enhancement of AI solutions and user experience.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree or above in Digital Transformation, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Project Management, or a related field.

Minimum 4–5+ years of experience in operations, digital transformation, project management, sales operations, training-related roles, e-commerce, ideally involving AI or technology-driven tools and initiatives.

Solid understanding of AI applications, intelligent agents, automation solutions, and digital business tools.

Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interpret business and operational data.

Excellent in local and English communication skills, written and spoken. Chinese Language is a plus.

Benefits

Opportunity to lead AI transformation initiatives across Europe.

Exposure to global AI and digital innovation projects.

International collaboration with cross-functional teams worldwide.

Career growth within a rapidly evolving digital business environment.

Flexible working arrangements and multicultural work environment.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Program Manager based in India.

This is a mission-driven opportunity to oversee healthcare programs that expand access to safe, comprehensive cleft care across India.

You will serve as a key relationship manager for partner hospitals, healthcare professionals, and implementation teams across multiple locations.

The role combines program delivery, quality assurance, compliance, stakeholder management, and performance monitoring.

You will use program data and field insights to identify gaps, strengthen partner capabilities, and improve outcomes.

With approximately 40–50% travel, including to remote and field locations, you will work closely with partners on the ground.

The position offers significant autonomy while collaborating with regional, medical, communications, and operational teams.

Your work will directly contribute to stronger healthcare systems and better outcomes for children affected by cleft conditions.

Accountabilities

Partner relationship management: Serve as the primary point of contact for partner hospitals and treatment teams, maintaining regular communication, addressing operational and patient-related concerns, collecting required documentation, and ensuring alignment with program protocols and partnership agreements.
Program implementation: Oversee program delivery across the assigned geographic area, conduct monitoring visits, assess performance and patient-care standards, identify implementation gaps, and coordinate improvements with partners and internal stakeholders.
Quality and compliance: Monitor adherence to safety, reporting, documentation, branding, and program requirements; facilitate audits and quality reviews; track corrective actions; and support the appropriate management and escalation of patient complaints and significant incidents.
Capacity building: Support the onboarding of new partners and practitioners, facilitate training initiatives and workshops, and work with medical advisors and subject-matter experts to strengthen partner capabilities and program quality.
Financial management: Monitor partner budget utilization, review funding applications against program guidelines, and support financial audits and follow-up actions where required.
Communications and representation: Represent the program at partner meetings, training sessions, and relevant events while supporting awareness initiatives, partner engagement, patient stories, case studies, and adherence to communication guidelines.
Monitoring and evaluation: Track program performance and outcomes through reporting systems and key indicators, analyze data to identify operational challenges and opportunities, and provide regular insights and updates to regional leadership.
Cross-functional coordination: Work effectively with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues, manage competing priorities, improve processes, and ensure programs remain aligned with broader strategic objectives.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Healthcare Management, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Business Administration, or a related field; a master's degree in Public Health, Public Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
Relevant experience: 6–8 years of experience managing or implementing programs within public health, healthcare, nonprofit, development, or related sectors.
Healthcare program expertise: Demonstrated experience working with healthcare providers, hospitals, hospital networks, public health programs, or other healthcare institutions, ideally across multiple sites.
Partnership management: Proven ability to manage implementation partners, build collaborative relationships, coordinate diverse stakeholders, and maintain effective communication across organizations.
Program delivery: Strong experience in program implementation, monitoring, reporting, compliance, quality assurance, and operational improvement.
Data and analytical skills: Ability to analyze program performance data, identify implementation gaps, monitor key indicators, and translate findings into practical improvements and decisions.
Project management: Strong program and project management capabilities, including the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, manage timelines, and work independently in a dynamic environment.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, coordination, stakeholder engagement, and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Problem-solving: Strong analytical, decision-making, solution-oriented, and issue-resolution capabilities.
Technical proficiency: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and program management, reporting, dashboard, or data-management tools.
Sector experience: Experience with national or international public health programs, maternal and child health, surgical care, healthcare systems strengthening, NGOs, INGOs, or donor-funded programs is an advantage.
Field readiness: Willingness and ability to travel frequently—approximately 40–50% of the time—including visits to partner hospitals, program sites, and remote districts across assigned states.
Personal competencies: Demonstrates ownership, emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, transparency, adaptability, collaboration, and a strong commitment to shared accountability and mission-driven work.

Benefits

Gross annual compensation of INR 19,20,000 to INR 21,00,000, with the final offer based on qualifications, relevant experience, and salary history.
Full-time remote position based in India.
Meaningful opportunity to contribute to healthcare access and improve outcomes for children affected by cleft lip and palate.
High-impact role with significant responsibility for program quality, partner performance, and continuous improvement.
Opportunity to work with diverse healthcare partners and stakeholders across multiple locations.
Exposure to national and international public health, healthcare delivery, and systems-strengthening initiatives.
Approximately 40–50% field travel, providing direct engagement with partner hospitals and program sites.
Inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven working environment.
Equal-opportunity workplace committed to diversity and inclusion.
Professional development through collaboration with internal teams, healthcare professionals, and subject-matter experts.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager: Medical Communications
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager: Medical Communications based in the United States.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced project manager to lead complex medical communications programmes supporting pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.

You will oversee multiple accounts and workstreams, ensuring high-quality delivery across publications, advisory boards, medical education, and other communications initiatives.

The role combines strategic project oversight with hands-on management of timelines, budgets, resources, and cross-functional teams.

You will work closely with clients, authors, healthcare stakeholders, and internal teams to keep programmes aligned and moving efficiently.

Your expertise will help ensure publications and communications materials meet quality, compliance, and industry standards.

You will also play a key role in identifying risks, managing scope, and resolving delivery challenges before they impact project outcomes.

The position offers a fully remote, collaborative environment with opportunities to grow your expertise within the medical communications field.

Accountabilities

Manage multiple client accounts and project workstreams simultaneously, ensuring programmes are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, status reports, hot sheets, Statements of Work (SOWs), and financial tracking documentation.
Lead publications project management activities across manuscripts, abstracts, and posters, coordinating author review cycles, publication timelines, journal requirements, and adherence to Good Publication Practice (GPP) guidelines.
Coordinate advisory board programmes from initial planning and logistics through briefing materials, meeting execution, and post-meeting reporting.
Oversee the development and delivery of medical communications materials, including presentation decks, training resources, medical education content, and related deliverables.
Manage project budgets, resource allocation, financial tracking, and cross-functional teams across a portfolio of programmes.
Coordinate and facilitate MLR review processes, helping ensure regulatory and compliance requirements are met while keeping client review cycles on schedule.
Proactively identify and communicate project risks, scope changes, resource constraints, and delivery challenges, implementing solutions to keep programmes on track.
Build effective relationships with clients and internal stakeholders, providing clear communication and maintaining strong project visibility throughout delivery.

Requirements

4–6 years of project management experience within a medical communications agency or a related healthcare or pharmaceutical environment.
Strong hands-on experience managing publications programmes, advisory boards, and a range of medical communications deliverables.
Demonstrated expertise in project budgeting, resource planning, financial tracking, and overall programme coordination.
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical compliance requirements and MLR review processes.
Familiarity with publication workflows, author engagement, journal submission requirements, and Good Publication Practice (GPP) guidelines.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working with clients, cross-functional teams, authors, and other stakeholders.
Proven ability to identify risks, resolve challenges, manage changing requirements, and maintain delivery momentum in a fast-paced environment.
Highly collaborative, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

Benefits

Compensation of $100,000–$115,000.
Fully remote working arrangement.
20 days of paid annual leave, prorated for new starters, with additional entitlement considered for more senior hires.
Company-paid life insurance.
Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage.
Medical insurance, with employees contributing 15% of monthly premiums through pre-tax payroll deductions.
Health Savings Account (HSA), including company contributions toward eligible deductibles.
Dental and vision insurance, with employees contributing 15% of monthly premiums through pre-tax payroll deductions.
401(k) retirement plan with Safe Harbor employer matching following the applicable eligibility period.

One additional PTO day for each year of service after the third anniversary, up to five additional days.

Über Atos

Atos ist die Marke der Atos Group für KI-gestützte, sichere und ganzheitliche digitale Services. Atos entwirft, entwickelt und betreibt kritische digitale Umgebungen, die Leistungsfähigkeit, Ausfallsicherheit und Souveränität fördern. So unterstützt Atos öffentliche und private Organisationen weltweit dabei, die Kontrolle über ihre Daten und IT-Infrastrukturen zu bewahren und gleichzeitig regulatorische Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

Mit mehr als 54.000 Mitarbeitenden betreut Atos über 4.500 Kunden in 54 Ländern, und unterstützt sie bei der Modernisierung ihrer zentralen IT-Systeme, der Beschleunigung ihrer Cloud- und Datentransformation, der Stärkung ihrer Cybersicherheit sowie der Bereitstellung sicherer digitaler Arbeitsplatzlösungen – zum Nutzen seiner Kunden, ihrer Mitarbeitenden und der Gesellschaft. Darüber hinaus bietet Atos unter der Marke Atos Amplify Beratungsleistungen an.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner beim Betrieb komplexer und geschäftskritischer Umgebungen unterstützt Atos Organisationen in stark regulierten und souveränen Kontexten.

Über die Atos Group

Die Atos Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. Mit ca. 56.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz von ca. 7,2 Mrd. EUR (auf Basis des künftigen Unternehmenszuschnitts) agiert das Unternehmen in 54 Ländern unter zwei Marken Atos für Services und Eviden für Produkte und Systeme. Als europäische Nummer eins in der Cybersicherheit und führend im Bereich Cloud arbeitet die Atos Group für eine sichere und dekarbonisierte Zukunft und bietet maßgeschneiderte KI-gestützte End-to-End Lösungen für alle Branchen. Atos Group ist an der Euronext Paris notiert.

Wir suchen neue Kolleg innen an unseren bundesweiten Standorten.

Unser SAP-Team besteht im deutschsprachigen Raum aus langjährig erfahrenen SAP-Beratern, die branchenübergreifend Transformationsprojekte und -programme im SAP S4/HANA Umfeld planen, umsetzen und betreiben. In dieser Rolle bist Du verantwortlich für das Erreichen der Projektziele, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are currently seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the delivery of electrical infrastructure projects across Victoria.
This role sits within the electrical, utilities, and infrastructure space and would suit someone with a strong background within the electrical infrastructure and renewable energy space.

While the title is Project Manager, this is very much a hybrid role that requires someone who can comfortably bridge the gap between project management and technical delivery.
You'll be working closely with engineering, commissioning, and site teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

Projects & Work Scope

You'll be supporting the delivery of projects that may include:
HV substation upgrades and infrastructure projects
Renewable energy developments
Grid connection works
Electrical infrastructure upgrades
Commissioning and energisation activities
Network and utility-related projects
Brownfield and greenfield electrical works

The role will require someone who understands project delivery from both a management and technical perspective, including how engineering, construction, testing, and commissioning activities all come together.

Key Responsibilities

Lead project delivery activities from initiation through to completion
Coordinate engineers, contractors, commissioning teams, and stakeholders
Manage project schedules, costs, risks, and reporting
Support commissioning and project handover activities
Work closely with site delivery and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges
Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget
Manage stakeholder communication across clients, suppliers, and internal teams
Assist with procurement, planning, outage coordination, and project execution where required

About You

To be successful, you'll ideally bring:
Previous experience as a Project Manager, Project Engineer, or Senior Project Engineer
Experience within the electrical infrastructure and renewable energy sectors would be highly regarded
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
Experience working across project delivery and commissioning activities
Ability to confidently engage with technical teams and understand engineering challenges
A hands-on, solutions-focused approach to project delivery

Why Apply?

Immediate start available
Exposure to major electrical infrastructure projects
Opportunity to work closely with engineering and commissioning teams
Diverse and technically interesting project environment

The ideal candidate should possess hands-on experience in commercial interior execution, civil works, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, networking, fire & safety systems, furniture installation, and finishing works. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Construction)
jobs.description:
For over 40 years, Archmill House Inc. has been a trusted leader in the creation of high-end millwork and premium store fixtures across North America. Our legacy is built on delivering exceptional craftsmanship, innovative solutions, and unwavering commitment to quality. This dedication has allowed us to become a preferred partner for a wide range of commercial and retail sectors.

At Archmill House, we take pride in our ability to evolve with the industry while maintaining our commitment to precision, efficiency, and client satisfaction. Our latest innovation, the Rapid Re-Image™ program, exemplifies this commitment. This cutting-edge restaurant remodeling solution is designed to meet the unique demands of Quick Service Restaurants, offering swift, flawless transformations that minimize disruption and maximize return on investment.

By integrating our expertise in millwork with the Rapid Re-Image™ program, Archmill House not only delivers superior renovations but also reinforces our reputation for excellence. We understand the importance of minimizing downtime, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring that every project we undertake reflects the high standards that have defined our brand for decades. With a robust presence across Canada and the United States, we continue to set the benchmark for quality and innovation in the industry.

Position Summary

The Senior Project Manager plays a critical leadership role in overseeing the successful delivery of complex, high-value projects for our corporate clients throughout the US and Canada. This is a senior-level position intended for an accomplished project management professional with extensive industry knowledge, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to independently lead projects from planning through execution and closeout.

The successful candidate will bring significant project and business leadership experience, while remaining actively involved in project execution. They will serve as a senior resource to the Project Management team, providing leadership, guidance, problem-solving support, and mentorship while maintaining direct accountability for their assigned portfolio of projects.

This position requires someone who can confidently interact with senior client representatives, internal leadership, subcontractors, vendors, and cross-functional teams while making sound business decisions with minimal oversight.

The position is hybrid, combining work from the office, home, and active project sites. Projects typically last from one to two weeks, and travel throughout the US and Canada is required.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the planning, coordination, execution, and successful completion of multiple complex construction and renovation projects simultaneously.
Take full ownership of assigned projects from initial handoff through construction, completion, financial closeout, and lessons learned.
Provide senior-level oversight and strategic direction to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to Archmill's quality standards.
Manage a significant annual project portfolio, including multiple concurrent projects across different geographic locations.
Develop, manage, and continuously assess project scope, schedules, budgets, forecasts, risks, and resource requirements.
Identify potential project, financial, scheduling, or operational risks early and develop practical mitigation strategies.
Serve as a senior point of contact for key clients and maintain strong relationships with client executives, representatives, vendors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
Lead challenging client conversations, project escalations, scope changes, schedule concerns, and commercial discussions.
Partner closely with Sales, Design, Pre-Construction, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Site Management, and other internal teams to ensure successful project execution.
Oversee subcontractor and vendor performance and ensure contractual commitments, schedules, quality expectations, and project requirements are met.
Negotiate with subcontractors, suppliers, and project partners to achieve favourable commercial and operational outcomes.
Review and interpret construction drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, change orders, budgets, and other project documentation.
Review project financial performance, including costs, forecasts, change orders, commitments, margins, and potential financial exposure.
Provide leadership with timely visibility into significant project risks, client concerns, financial issues, or schedule impacts, along with recommended solutions.
Conduct and participate in project meetings, milestone reviews, site meetings, and post-project evaluations.
Provide guidance and mentorship to Project Managers and other members of the project team, sharing best practices and supporting their development.
Act as a senior escalation resource for complex project issues and assist other Project Managers in resolving difficult situations when required.
Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, systems, reporting, communication, and overall project delivery.
Support leadership with broader departmental or business initiatives based on experience and operational knowledge.
Maintain a safe and professional work environment and demonstrate strong leadership in health and safety.
Ensure projects comply with applicable local, state/provincial, and federal regulations, building codes, contractual requirements, and safety standards.
Perform other related duties and strategic project assignments as required.

Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Building Science, Engineering, Architecture, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
10–15+ years of progressively responsible project management and construction experience, with significant experience managing complex, multi-site or high-value projects.
Extensive experience independently managing projects from planning through execution and closeout.
Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, sound judgment, and accountability, making complex project and business decisions with minimal supervision.
Strong experience managing senior-level client relationships, including challenging project situations and escalations.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities, tight schedules, and geographically dispersed teams.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project budgets, forecasting, margins, change management, contracts, and cost control.
Extensive experience negotiating with and managing subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, and other external partners.
Advanced understanding of construction methods, sequencing, scheduling, drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation.
Experience within design-build, retail construction, millwork, QSR, restaurant, or multi-site rollout environments is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate risk, analyze complex problems, and implement practical solutions.
Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive accountability.
Experience coaching and mentoring Project Managers and other project professionals is strongly preferred.
Exceptional client-facing, negotiation, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
PMP or another relevant project/construction management designation is considered an asset.
Strong work ethic, professional judgment, accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering results.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30–50% of the time throughout the US and Canada.
Must have a valid Driver’s License.

WORK CONDITIONS

Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30-50% of the time.
Required to work in a construction setting which contains loud noises.
Required to wear Personal Protective Equipment.
Required to remain standing for extended periods of time.

CHARACTERISTICS TO SUCCEED

At Archmill House Inc., we are seeking Ideal Team Players who are Humble, Hungry and Smart (as referenced by Patrick Lencioni in his book, The Ideal Team Player).

Humble – Who shares the credit and success with team members
Hungry – Who is always looking for more responsibilities and learnings
Smart – Who is emotionally intelligent and has good judgement

We pursue individuals who have an “All In” attitude. "All In" means showing unwavering commitment, embracing teamwork, and going above and beyond to drive success for our company, our colleagues, and our clients.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US

Paid Sick/Family Emergency Days
Training & Professional Development Opportunities
Employee Assistance Program
Extended Travel Policy

In-Office Bistro with Snacks & Refreshments
Frequent Social Committee Events

OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUITY & INCLUSION

Archmill House Inc.

The Electro Optical Infrared Systems (EOIS) line of business within DRS has locations in Dallas and Austin, TX, Melbourne, FL, and Cypress, CA. Employing the world’s brightest. Supporting the world’s bravest.

Location: Dallas, TX

Career Functional Area: Supply Chain

Type: Exempt Employee

Job Summary

The Manager, II Program Management - Supply Chain works heavily with program management, engineering, supply chain and key suppliers in sourcing and execution of all order for specific programs. This individual utilizes their understanding of program level schedule, cost, and business requirements, integrate into a cohesive direction to a material planning organization, and supply chain function. The Manager ensures timely and high integrity proposals, planning of materials. This role utilizes their understanding of the critical aspects of production material demand planning and scheduling of a project and experience in the overall proposal and procurement process in a DoD environment. This position will work closely with a team of material planners, purchasing, engineering, and program management to deploy procurement and inventory strategies, be responsible for product change and associated material planning implications, manage and solve exceptions, and work with purchasing to drive supplier execution. This role involves critical monitoring and management of supply and constraints, status reporting and escalation, supplier engagement and the relentless pursuit of operation excellence and continuous improvement.

This role manages and directs the daily execution of contract requirements to assure that cost, schedules and performance goals are met. This Manager may lead or support all meetings and the integrated product and/or project team (kick-off through project close), as well as provides interface, communication and coordination with internal and external customers on matters pertaining to existing contracts. This Manager will lead and or support bid and proposal activities. Responsibilities are conducted under the guidance of senior level management (Director of Programs, or LOB Lead).

Job Responsibilities

Manage and direct the daily execution of contract requirements to assure that cost, schedules and performance goals are met
Lead all meetings and the integrated product team from kick-off through project close
Provide interface, communication and coordination with internal and external customers on matters pertaining to existing contracts
Participate as a team member or leader on bid and proposal activities. Ensure that the requirements of the request for proposal are met in the preparation and documentation of bids and proposals for existing customers
Actively seek new business opportunities in coordination with Business Development
Represent management at program reviews, meetings, seminars, etc.
Prepare for and participate in contract/subcontract negotiations. While representing Company’s interests, assure that all government regulatory guidance is adhered to
Develop and implement plans and schedules to execute contracts/subcontracts. Allocate and control contract budgets for labor, material, travel and purchased services. Regularly report program status to senior management
Formally identify, assess, monitor and mitigate risk throughout the program life cycle. Obtains management approval prior to making decisions that will cause deterioration of established program, cost and schedule objectives.
May be required to ensure the overall execution of material on schedule and on budget for a business area
May be required to collaborate on various tasks with various project teams
May be required to various tasks/team/project/Engineering changes

5+ years of relevent experience
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience (Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain or Business degree may be preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience depending upon the job discipline)
Knowledge of program management tools and procedures
Solid leadership and management skills
Exposure to program lifecycle from development through sustainment to include: proposal development, requirements decomposition, generation of system and subsystem statements of work and subcontracts, risk management, and continuous improvement efforts including implementation cost reduction and performance improvement efforts
Exposure to earned value cost accounting and reporting; experience with metrics for assessing and reporting program progress, productivity and variance analysis
Exposure to finance, contracting, export regulations, engineering, logistics, manufacturing and supply chain management
Strong skills in customer interfacing, problm solving, presenting, and overall communication

to support clients in implementing federally- and state-funded residential mitigation grant projects.  This position is hybrid with on-site work in Los Angeles County, CA.
The Senior Project Manager will be focused on leading residential property mitigation projects to reduce the risk to homes and property from natural hazards including wildfires, wind, ice storms, and severe weather.

The ideal candidate will be a proven Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Hazard Mitigation Assistance (HMA) Project Manager
with a track record of superior execution and growth and will be responsible for ensuring that programs are positioned to optimize disaster grant resource allocation, build strong solutions to impacted areas, and provide strong risk management. This position represents an exceptional opportunity to join an expert team to facilitate change and help make a lasting difference.

Lead the development, coordination, and operation of various large, complex federally funded programs, focused on residential mitigation and community resilience, from start up through closeout.
Serve as an expert in FEMA HMA grant programs and advise local government and private non-profit clients on large-scale mitigation projects.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced OT Cyber Security Manager to lead the development and execution of cybersecurity strategy across Operational Technology (OT) environments.

This is a critical leadership role responsible for securing industrial control systems, SCADA environments, manufacturing systems, and critical operational infrastructure. You'll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, IT, Risk, and operational stakeholders to strengthen cyber resilience, reduce risk, and ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Governance

Develop and maintain the OT cybersecurity strategy and roadmap aligned to business objectives.
Establish OT security policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
Provide expert guidance on OT cyber risk, controls, investments, and best practices.
Lead OT cybersecurity audits and remediation activities.

Risk Management & Compliance

Conduct OT cyber risk assessments and vulnerability reviews.
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks across industrial and operational environments.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and frameworks including:
IEC 62443
NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
NIS2
ISO 27001

Support compliance with sector-specific regulatory requirements.

Security Architecture & Implementation

Design and maintain secure OT network architectures.
Ensure effective segmentation between IT and OT environments.
Review and approve OT technology deployments from a cybersecurity perspective.
Support the secure adoption of Industrial IoT (IIoT), cloud-connected systems, and remote access solutions.

Incident Response & Operational Security

Develop and maintain OT-specific incident response processes.
Lead investigations and response activities for OT cybersecurity incidents.
Coordinate with IT Security Operations, engineering teams, and third-party providers during security events.
Monitor emerging OT threats and vulnerabilities.

Asset Security & Continuous Improvement

Maintain visibility of OT assets, systems, and communication networks.
Oversee OT vulnerability management, patching, and remediation programmes.
Ensure secure configuration and lifecycle management of industrial assets.
Drive continuous improvement across OT security controls and operational resilience.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the primary OT cybersecurity subject matter expert.
Partner with plant managers, engineers, maintenance teams, and IT security teams.
Manage relationships with external suppliers, auditors, and regulatory bodies.
Deliver security awareness programmes and promote a security-first culture across operational teams.

Essential Skills & Experience

Proven experience in Operational Technology (OT) Cyber Security leadership roles.
Strong knowledge of:
Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
SCADA environments
Manufacturing and operational technology networks

Experience developing and implementing OT cybersecurity strategies and governance frameworks.
Strong understanding of OT security architecture, network segmentation, and industrial protocols.
Experience managing OT security incidents, vulnerabilities, and risk assessments.
Knowledge of OT-focused cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including:
IEC 62443
NIST CSF
NIS2
ISO 27001

Ability to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Industrial IoT (IIoT) security.
Critical national infrastructure, utilities, manufacturing, energy, or defence sector experience.
Cloud-connected industrial systems.
Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent.
Experience managing third-party security providers and regulatory engagements.

About The Role

MiniMed is looking for an EHS Program Manager. The EHS Program Manager is responsible for leading and managing Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) programs to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations and to support operational excellence and a strong safety culture across the organization. This role will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, and R&D teams to proactively identify risks, implement effective controls, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

The ideal candidate is a proactive safety leader with strong technical expertise, regulatory knowledge, environmental compliance experience, and the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization. Experience with EHS management systems such as Gensuite, VelocityEHS, and Enablon is highly preferred.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

Lead and manage site EHS programs to ensure compliance with Cal/OSHA, EPA, AQMD, DTSC, CUPA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve safety programs, policies, procedures, and standards across the organization.
Partner with Operations, Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, and R&D teams to integrate EHS requirements into daily operations and new projects.
Drive proactive safety initiatives focused on hazard recognition, risk reduction, incident prevention, and continuous improvement.
Conduct and oversee incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
Manage site safety metrics, KPIs, leading and lagging indicators, and prepare management reports and presentations.
Lead risk assessments, Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), ergonomic evaluations, and safety reviews for new equipment, processes, and facility changes.
Manage and oversee critical safety programs, including:
Laser Safety Program
Radiation Safety Program

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager - Virtual Credit Cards (VCC)
jobs.description:
Job Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Business Operations Management

VCC Lifecycle Management:
Manage daily operations of Virtual Credit Cards (VCC), covering the full lifecycle including virtual card bin application, limit configuration, activation/freezing, and expiration cancellation, to meet scenario-based needs such as airline/GDS ticket procurement, hotel pre-authorization, and bulk DMC (Destination Management Company) payments.
Client & Stakeholder Support:
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external clients to resolve card usage inquiries and transaction anomalies (e.g., failed charges, chargebacks), enhancing customer satisfaction and product stickiness.

2. Data-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

Metrics Monitoring & Reporting
: Monitor core operational metrics (card issuance rate, transaction volume/value, chargeback rate, capital occupation cost) and produce daily/weekly/monthly reports to identify business pain points and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Process Optimization:
Review VCC business processes (such as account opening approval, reconciliation & settlement, exception handling), propose optimization solutions and drive implementation — e.g., integrate with ERP systems to enable automated reconciliation, reducing 70%+ manual operations.
Travel Scenario Optimization:
Optimize VCC limit allocation, validity period settings, and merchant lock rules based on travel industry characteristics (such as urgent ticketing, fragmented high-frequency orders) to improve capital efficiency and order conversion rates.

3. Risk Management & Compliance Assurance

Regulatory & Industry Compliance:
Implement payment industry compliance requirements, ensuring operations adhere to PCI DSS data security standards, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, and cross-border payment regulatory requirements; coordinate with internal audits and external compliance inspections.
Fraud & Risk Mitigation:
Monitor suspicious transactions and collaborate with the risk control team to develop fraud interception strategies, utilizing merchant locks, dynamic limit controls, and one-click freezing to prevent unauthorized transactions and fund risks.
Policy Adaptation:
Track changes in payment industry policies and card organization rules, promptly adjust operational strategies to ensure business compliance.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Resource Integration

Sales Enablement:
Assist with the sales team to promote VCC business, providing product training, operational guidelines, and pre-sales support to facilitate customer acquisition and conversion.
Product & Technical Alignment
: Work closely with product and engineering teams to communicate business requirements (such as system functionality enhancements and automation tool development), driving iterative upgrades of the VCC management system to improve operational efficiency.
Knowledge Sharing:
Establish internal knowledge-sharing mechanisms to disseminate VCC usage tips and scenario-based solutions to business teams, enhancing company-wide product proficiency.

Job Requirements

1. Essential Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or above, with preference given to majors in International Trade, Tourism Management, Finance, E-Commerce, or related fields.
3-5 years of operational experience in the travel industry (airline tickets/hotels/corporate travel management) or cross-border payment/VCC business operations; candidates familiar with GDS systems, airline settlement processes, or corporate travel management models are preferred.
Possess fundamental data analysis capabilities.

2. Core Competencies

Communication & Coordination
: Ability to efficiently liaise with multiple internal and external stakeholders (customers, banks, technology teams) and resolve cross-functional, cross-scenario collaboration challenges.
Risk Acumen
: Strong awareness of payment industry risks, with the ability to respond swiftly to transaction anomalies and regulatory shifts, balancing business growth with risk control.

Stress Tolerance & Problem-Solving
: Able to thrive in fast-paced, high-urgency travel industry environments, independently resolving card disputes, payment outages, and unexpected emergencies.
Industry Knowledge:
Deep understanding of pain points in travel-related cross-border payments (such as currency exchange costs, capital occupation, complex reconciliation); familiarity with VCC product features and application scenarios is preferred.

jobs.description:
Project cum Site Manager

We are seeking an experienced Project cum Site Manager to manage the planning, production coordination, transportation, and on-site installation of precast concrete beams. The successful candidate will ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with technical and quality requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Project Planning and Management

Plan and schedule precast beam production, transportation, delivery, and installation.
Coordinate with design engineers to ensure shop drawings and structural requirements are properly reviewed and followed.
Monitor project progress, budgets, timelines, manpower, and resources.
Identify project risks and implement appropriate corrective actions.
Prepare progress reports, forecasts, and project updates for management and stakeholders.

Site Execution and Supervision

Supervise the installation of precast beams according to approved structural drawings, specifications, and method statements.
Manage site logistics, crane operations, lifting plans, rigging activities, and beam installation sequences.
Coordinate manpower, subcontractors, materials, machinery, and equipment.
Supervise site engineers, subcontractors, and workers to maintain safe and efficient operations.
Conduct daily site inspections and monitor workmanship, safety, and quality compliance.
Ensure site activities are completed promptly to prevent project delays or operational disruptions.

Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate closely with factory production teams, transport providers, design teams, and site installation crews.
Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, and management regarding project progress and requirements.
Resolve technical, logistical, and operational issues affecting project delivery.
Escalate critical issues to management with appropriate recommendations.

Safety, Environmental and Regulatory Compliance

Enforce lifting safety procedures and applicable occupational health and safety requirements.
Conduct risk assessments for the handling, storage, transportation, lifting, and installation of precast components.
Ensure compliance with the company’s safety, health, environmental, and quality policies.
Stop work immediately when an unsafe condition or environmental risk is identified.
Report accidents, non-compliance, spills, leaks, or environmental incidents without delay.
Maintain accurate documentation for audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance.
Participate in safety and environmental training and awareness programmes.
Perform other duties assigned by the immediate superior, manager, or Head of Department.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
At least five years of experience in precast concrete projects, covering both production and site installation.
Hands-on experience with cranes, lifting plans, rigging activities, and precast installation sequencing.
Recognized safety management certification, such as CIDB or an equivalent qualification, is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

Strong knowledge of precast concrete production, transportation, handling, storage, and installation methods.
Good understanding of lifting equipment, rigging safety, crane operations, and site logistics.
Ability to read and interpret structural drawings, shop drawings, specifications, and method statements.
Strong project-management, leadership, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency in project-management tools and reporting systems.
Strong commitment to safety, quality, environmental compliance, and timely project delivery.

Key Authority

The Project cum Site Manager is authorized to:
Make operational decisions within the approved project scope, budget, and timeline.
Deploy manpower, subcontractors, materials, machinery, and equipment.
Approve site activities and work methods within the designated authority.
Enforce contractual, safety, environmental, and quality requirements.
Coordinate directly with clients, consultants, contractors, and management.
Stop work when unsafe conditions or environmental risks are identified.
Report incidents and non-compliance and initiate immediate corrective action.

Interested candidates are invited to apply with an updated résumé and details of relevant precast concrete project experience.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Position:
Deployment Strategist

Location:
Boston, NYC, Washington DC (On-Site)

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how organizations engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and business development is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm’s AI brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Big data, meets CRM, meets AI. Our mission is simple: deliver the right capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Deployment Strategists are the tip of the spear at Pryzm: the people who sit at the intersection of software, strategy, and mission. This is not a traditional implementation role. You will embed directly with our customers in the national security and federal technology space, learn their hardest problems, and build the workflows, analyses, and operational capabilities that transform how they work.

You will work alongside engineers and GTM teams to shape the roadmap, represent the customer's voice inside Pryzm, and ensure that our platform delivers measurable impact in the field. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build trust with operators and executives alike, and are driven by outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Embed with customers to understand their workflows, priorities, and decision-making processes from the inside out
Design and deploy tailored workflows and analytical tools using the Pryzm platform to solve real operational problems
Translate ambiguous mission requirements into clear product configurations, data integrations, and actionable insights
Build and maintain trusted relationships with end users, program managers, and senior leaders at customer organizations
Partner with Pryzm’s engineering teams to communicate what’s working, what’s missing, and what matters most
Drive adoption and capability expansion within existing accounts, identifying new use cases and stakeholders
Develop training materials, playbooks, and documentation that scale your impact beyond direct engagement
Support business development by participating in demos, capability briefings, and proposal efforts

What We’re Looking For

2–5 years of experience in a high-impact, customer-facing role, either or already as a Deployment Strategist or Forward Deployed Engineer, or elsewhere, such as within consulting, federal contracting, SaaS implementation, or a hybrid.
Demonstrated ability to work directly with operators and decision-makers in government or national security environments
Strong analytical instincts: comfortable with data, able to structure complex problems, and fast at learning new tools
A builder’s mindset: you don’t wait to be told what to do; you identify the gap and close it
Outstanding communication skills with an ability to translate technical concepts for a variety of audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments
Experience with government procurement, capture management, or the federal technology ecosystem is a strong plus.
Bonus: if you are technical and can write code too!

Qualifications

Located in or willing to relocate to New York, Washington DC, or Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply
Willingness for regular customer travel

Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents
Relocation assistance available

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

jobs.title: Cyber Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

MITRE is seeking a Cyber Analyst to join our Digital Investigations Department and contribute to challenging national security, law enforcement, cyber, and public-interest missions.

Our work focuses on transforming digital data into actionable understanding. We combine technical analysis, investigative tradecraft, data analytics, and mission context to answer difficult questions, reconstruct events, identify malicious activity, reveal relationships, and support operational decision-making.

Our staff work across a range of digital investigation specialties, including digital evidence and forensics, open-source and digital intelligence, investigative analytics, adversary and activity analysis, operational investigations, and the development of new investigative capabilities and tradecraft.

This position is well suited for a technical professional who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working with diverse types of digital data, learning new technologies, and applying technical skills to real-world investigative challenges.

Roles & Responsibilities:

In this role, the selected candidate may contribute to efforts that:

Acquire and Analyze Digital Evidence: Collect, preserve, examine, and interpret digital data from endpoints, mobile devices, networks, cloud environments, applications, and other digital sources.
Conduct Digital Intelligence and OSINT Analysis: Collect and analyze publicly available and online information, which may include social media, online identities, digital infrastructure, cryptocurrency activity, dark web sources, and other internet-based data.
Perform Investigative Data Analysis: Fuse, correlate, analyze, and visualize information from multiple sources to identify relationships, reconstruct events, resolve entities, discover patterns, and generate investigative insights.
Analyze Targets and Malicious Activity: Examine people, organizations, infrastructure, software, and digital behavior to better understand adversaries, campaigns, malicious activity, and complex digital interactions.
Support Operational Investigations: Apply technical and analytical methods to cyber, law enforcement, counterintelligence, insider threat, fraud, and other national security investigations and use findings to inform operational decisions.
Develop Investigative Capabilities and Tradecraft: Prototype and evaluate tools, automation, AI-enabled approaches, analytical methods, standards, and workflows that make digital investigations more effective, scalable, and repeatable.
Evaluate Investigative Technologies: Assess tools, platforms, datasets, and emerging technologies to understand their strengths, limitations, and applicability to investigative missions.
Communicate Technical Findings: Develop clear analytical products, visualizations, briefings, and technical documentation that explain findings and their implications to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborate Across Disciplines: Work with investigators, analysts, software engineers, data scientists, researchers, mission experts, and sponsor stakeholders to solve complex problems.
Explore Emerging Problems: Research unfamiliar technologies, datasets, and investigative challenges; develop hypotheses; test analytical approaches; and identify new opportunities for technical innovation.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Data Science, Digital Forensics, Information Technology, Engineering, Intelligence Studies, or a related technical or analytical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Approximately 2 years of relevant professional, academic, research, internship, military, or law enforcement experience involving cybersecurity, digital investigations, data analysis, intelligence analysis, software or systems analysis, or a related area.
Foundational experience in one or more areas relevant to digital investigations, such as digital forensics, cybersecurity, OSINT, threat intelligence, data analytics, network analysis, malware analysis, software analysis, or investigative research.
Demonstrated ability to approach ambiguous technical or analytical problems, evaluate available information, develop hypotheses, and draw supportable conclusions.
Ability to work with structured or unstructured data and identify meaningful patterns, relationships, or anomalies.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts and analytical findings clearly.
Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies, tools, data sources, and mission areas.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of multidisciplinary teams.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 3 days onsite.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience or coursework in one or more of the following areas is preferred but not required:

Digital forensics or digital evidence acquisition and analysis, including endpoint, mobile, network, cloud, or application data.
Open-source intelligence, social media analysis, dark web research, online identity analysis, cryptocurrency or blockchain analysis, or digital infrastructure analysis.
Cyber threat intelligence, adversary tracking, malware analysis, attribution analysis, incident response, or intrusion analysis.
Data analysis, entity resolution, link analysis, graph analysis, statistics, data visualization, or analysis of large and complex datasets.
Programming or scripting using languages such as Python, R, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
Development of analytical tools, automation, prototypes, or repeatable technical workflows.
Application of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or large language models to analytical or investigative problems.
Familiarity with investigative, forensic, intelligence, data analytics, or security platforms and tools.
Experience conducting technical research, experimentation, tool evaluation, or comparative analysis.
Experience working with law enforcement, national security, intelligence, cyber operations, fraud, insider threat, or related mission areas.
Previous experience working in a classified environment or possession of an active U.S. government security clearance.

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
About this role
We are building an evaluation benchmark for frontier AI browsing agents. Your job is to design research problems that a state-of-the-art AI cannot solve, even with full web access and multiple attempts. This is not a subject matter expert role, nor is it a content-writing role. It is investigative research.
You will start from a verifiable fact, work backwards to construct a question that makes that fact extremely hard to locate, and then prove your work with a complete, auditable evidence trail.
What You Will Produce

A natural-language research question with a short, stable, objectively verifiable answer
Clues, each independently checkable, spanning multiple fact types - including dates, people, places, organisations, works, events, records, and quantities - with specific constraints
A validation record showing the obvious searches you ran and the results they returned

Minimum Qualifications

Demonstrated open-web research ability, including locating primary records and navigating government and institutional databases, archives, registries, and PDF documents
Precision with sourcing. You cite exact pages, tables, and sections—not just homepages
Comfort researching unfamiliar subjects from scratch
Native or near-native written English
High tolerance for structured documentation. The evidence trail is the majority of the work
Experience with LLM evaluation, red-teaming, or benchmark construction
Experience in one or more of the following domains:

Reference librarianship, archival research, or special collections
Investigative journalism or professional fact-checking
OSINT, due diligence, KYC, or investigative research
Patent, prior-art, or legal-discovery search
Genealogy and records research
Competitive quizzing or puzzle-hunt construction

Nice to Have

Familiarity with JSON and structured data delivery formats

jobs.title: Lead Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

The Strategic Non‑Kinetic Effects Mission Division is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst with deep, cross-disciplinary expertise in networking, intelligence, and cybersecurity to design and deliver mission-critical solutions to the nation’s most complex challenges.

Roles & Responsibilities:

The Department is currently seeking a senior-career cybersecurity professional to contribute individual technical expertise and support to a complex work program in support of critical national security objectives.

Responsibilities include:

Evaluating existing methodologies and developing recommendations for improved processes, tools, analytics, and infrastructure
Identifying and leveraging capabilities from across MITRE that enable the sponsor to measurably increase mission impact
Supporting intelligence collection operations by partnering closely with Sponsor leaders to apply human and technological capabilities that enable successful operational/mission outcomes
Conveying technical, analytic, and organizational findings, recommendations, and approaches to senior decision makers and mission partners.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Ability to work with others to solve challenging technical problems.
Ability to think critically, work in group settings, and be proactive in pursuing research and problem solving.
Experience with analyzing raw threat intelligence from one or more collection disciplines (ex. SIGINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, etc.) in support of operations and/or analysis.
Deep understanding of computer networks and the OSI model, spanning hardware, software, and networking components, including how data flows and is secured across all layers.
Experience with C5ISR-T analysis. Requires current, expert-level knowledge of C4 architectures relevant to adversary analysis.
Analytical experience related to technical subjects including telecommunications and network engineering.
Experience in all-source intelligence, threat hunting, vulnerability analysis, network reverse engineering and network reconnaissance.
Familiarity with intelligence community organizational and governance structures, and/or requirements processes.
Experience with intelligence community analytic and requirements tools.
Must have an active Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI w/Poly U.S. Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position has an on-site requirement of 5 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

Intelligence community acquisition, planning, programming, budgeting and execution experience.
Familiarity with the intent, capability and operations of top tier nation-station adversary threat groups targeting operational technology in critical infrastructure, space, or weapon systems.

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

Top Secret/SCI

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret/SCI/Polygraph

Onsite

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

If you've spent time studying or working outside Japan and you're ready to put that global perspective to work, this role was built for you. Japan's IT services market is one of the most complex and distinctive in the world — and IDC needs analysts who can read it from the inside while connecting it to what's happening globally. That combination is rare, and it's exactly what makes this role compelling.

About The Role

This is an opportunity to shape how the world understands Japan's IT services market — and to do it from Tokyo, at the center of one of Asia-Pacific's most dynamic technology ecosystems.

As a Research Analyst on IDC Japan's Services team, you will lead original research on Japan's IT services landscape, with a particular focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and domestic local vendors that define much of the market's character. You will contribute to two flagship IDC programs — the Japan Services CIS program and the Worldwide Semiannual Services Tracker — and collaborate closely with IDC's global and Asia-Pacific analyst network.

This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need.

What You’ll Do

Research & Analysis

Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players
Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers
Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis
Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services

Client Engagement & Business Development

Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance
Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services
Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends
Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers

Global Collaboration

Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership
Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments

What You Bring

We’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles:

IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market
Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions
Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles

Skills & Qualifications

Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan
English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan
Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word
Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team)
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.
A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.
