jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

MITRE is seeking an experienced technical professional to join our Digital Investigations Department in support of a high-impact sponsor mission in the McLean, Virginia area.

Our department transforms digital data into actionable understanding by combining technical analysis, investigative tradecraft, software development, data analytics, and mission context. Our work spans digital evidence and forensics, digital intelligence and OSINT, investigative analytics, target and activity analysis, operational investigations, and the development of new investigative tools and capabilities.

This position requires a strong Python developer who can work directly with sponsor personnel to understand mission problems, develop and evolve technical solutions, and provide technical leadership to other members of the team. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between hands-on development, technical problem solving, solution design, and direct sponsor interaction.

This is an on-site position supporting a sponsor location in the McLean, VA area
. Regular presence at the sponsor site is required.

Roles & Responsibilities:

In this role, the selected candidate will:

Lead Technical Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications, analytical tools, automation, and data-processing capabilities supporting digital investigations and related mission needs.
Set Technical Direction: Translate complex or ambiguous sponsor problems into technical approaches, make architecture and implementation decisions, and help establish the direction of work performed by other team members.
Remain Hands-On: Personally develop and review production-quality Python code while contributing to troubleshooting, debugging, integration, testing, and deployment activities.
Solve Complex Technical Problems: Analyze difficult technical and mission challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and apply sound engineering judgment to develop practical and innovative approaches.
Work Directly with Sponsors: Build a strong understanding of sponsor workflows, priorities, constraints, and operational needs and use that understanding to shape technical solutions.
Guide and Elevate the Team: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to more junior staff, conduct code and design reviews, share technical knowledge, and help improve the quality and effectiveness of the team's work.
Build Sustainable Capability: Develop reusable tools, libraries, workflows, documentation, and engineering practices that improve work beyond an individual task or project.
Connect Across Disciplines: Collaborate with investigators, analysts, data scientists, engineers, and other technical experts to integrate capabilities and solve multidisciplinary problems.
Communicate Technical Concepts: Explain complex technical issues, design decisions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Evaluate Technologies and Approaches: Assess existing and emerging software, data sources, platforms, and analytical techniques and identify opportunities to improve investigative capabilities and mission outcomes.

Basic Qualifications:

Strong software development experience using Python, including demonstrated experience developing, debugging, testing, and maintaining non-trivial software or analytical capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems and make sound technical design and implementation decisions.
Experience leading the technical direction of a project, task, capability, or significant body of work.
Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance, mentorship, or review of work performed by other engineers or analysts.
Experience translating user or mission needs into technical requirements and working solutions.
Experience developing software that interacts with, processes, transforms, or analyzes complex datasets.
Strong understanding of software engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, code review, and maintainable software design.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams and directly with sponsor or customer stakeholders.
Ability to work independently in an environment where requirements may be incomplete, evolving, or operationally driven.
Position is based in the McLean, Virginia area and requires regular on-site work at the sponsor location.
Access to a vehicle is required to support work at the sponsor site and associated local mission activities.
Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance . Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position requires a minimum of 4 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience developing software or analytical capabilities supporting digital investigations, cybersecurity, intelligence, law enforcement, national security, or other operational missions.
Experience with Python data and analytical libraries and frameworks such as pandas, NumPy, SQLAlchemy, FastAPI, Flask, or similar technologies.
Experience designing and implementing data pipelines, APIs, backend services, automation, or analytical workflows.
Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets, including data normalization, entity resolution, correlation, enrichment, or visualization.
Experience with relational and/or non-relational databases and strong SQL skills.
Experience working in Linux environments and with command-line tools and scripting.
Experience with Git-based development workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, or related DevSecOps practices.
Experience integrating software with external APIs, data services, investigative platforms, or mission systems.
Familiarity with one or more digital investigation areas such as digital forensics, OSINT, cyber threat intelligence, network analysis, malware analysis, cryptocurrency analysis, investigative analytics, or target/activity analysis.
Experience rapidly prototyping technical approaches and transitioning successful prototypes into sustainable capabilities.
Demonstrated experience identifying opportunities to improve technical practices or capabilities beyond an individual's assigned work.
Experience working directly with government sponsors in a classified environment.

jobs.description:
What The Role Is

MED is building its data and analytics capability, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. The Data Analyst will turn MED's operational, programme and policy questions into clear, reliable insights that support decision-making across the division. The officer will work with structured and unstructured data, develop dashboards and analytical products, support programme evaluation, and help MED team members use data more effectively. This role focuses on collecting, analysing and communicating data — it is distinct from a Business Analyst role.

What You Will Be Working On

The officer should focus on areas 1 to 4, with areas 5 and 6 pursued where capacity allows. Area 7 applies across all areas.

1. Data quality and documentation — Review, clean and document MED's operational datasets. Develop data dictionaries, validation rules and methodology notes so the data is reliable and easy for others to maintain.

2. Management dashboards and reporting — Work with MED team members to improve existing Tableau and Excel dashboards, and develop additional dashboards and reports where needed. Present findings as concise narratives with clear recommendations.

3. Programme evaluation — Using MOF's programme evaluation template as the framework, work with MED’s data team to analyse whether the MEP is achieving its intended outcomes and prepare the required reports and submissions for management and stakeholders.

4. Operational and thematic analysis — Identify trends, patterns, anomalies and risks in MEP operations. Conduct root-cause analysis of complaints, feedback and case records, and write up findings as clear analytical briefs.

5. Unstructured data analysis — Apply text analytics or AI-assisted methods to case notes, complaints and other documents to surface insights not captured in structured data.

6. AI-enabled analytics — Develop small-scale proof-of-concepts for AI or automation in MED's analytics work, with appropriate human oversight and governance.

7. Stakeholder engagement and capability building — Help MED teams frame analytical problems, advise on metrics and methods, and provide hands-on guidance to team members developing dashboards and analytical tools.

What We Are Looking For

Qualifications in data analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, public policy, social sciences or a related discipline, with relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, programme evaluation or operations analytics.
Proficiency in Excel and Tableau or equivalent is expected. Experience with SQL, Python or R, and familiarity with text analytics, NLP or generative AI would be an advantage.
Experience with public-sector operations or case-management data is useful but not essential.

Competencies:

[Data quality and collection] Cleans, validates and documents data; designs repeatable collection approaches.

[Analysis and modelling] Examines patterns and relationships; applies suitable quantitative methods with clear assumptions.

[Unstructured data and AI] Applies text analytics or AI methods responsibly, with human oversight and attention to risk.

[Charts and dashboards] Designs clear visualisations that support monitoring and decisions.

[Data storytelling] Communicates findings in plain language tailored to the audience.

[Stakeholder engagement] Frames analytical questions with users and supports appropriate interpretation of findings.

Key deliverables:

Management dashboards and recurring reports covering MED's priority indicators, including improvements to existing Tableau and Excel dashboards
Programme evaluation analysis supporting MED's MOF reporting commitment
Cleaned, documented datasets with data dictionaries and methodology notes to support handover and continued use after the contract ends
Thematic and trend analyses of complaints, surveys and case records, written up as analytical briefs with findings, implications and recommended actions
(Stretch) Validated AI-assisted workflows for document extraction or classification

This 11-month contract is intended to meet MED's immediate analytics and programme evaluation needs. The officer should be able to contribute with limited lead time and deliver usable outputs, documentation and knowledge transfer within the contract period. Appointment level and any applicable skills allowance remain subject to HR's assessment.

The National Project Manager plays a critical role in supporting the strategic and operational priorities of the Federal Court.

This position leads a team responsible for managing projects that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the Court’s judicial caseload and its chambers and registry operations which support the judicial work of the Court, while also overseeing governance frameworks and providing high-level executive coordination.

The role works closely with the Chambers of the Chief Justice to deliver outcomes aligned with the Court’s objectives. The role requires strong project management skills, leadership abilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to engage with senior stakeholders including judges.

Duties

Co-ordinate and assist in managing existing and new projects, including judge-led projects, that support the Court’s strategic and operational goals, ensuring timely delivery, effective implementation, resource management, and stakeholder engagement.
Coordinate and develop project plans and other project documentation, including scope, timelines, risk assessments, and reporting frameworks.
Lead and manage project staff, providing oversight over their work and ensuring they are appropriately trained and resourced to effectively complete tasks.
Ensure adequate and timely consultation with all external and internal stakeholders for any project.
Coordinate the preparation of reports, meeting agendas, minutes, follow-up actions and reports for senior leadership committees and project groups – including judge led committees and project groups.
Assist with implementation of projects and coordinating with all court staff and staff of the FCA Entity, who need to be involved in implementation of projects.
Where necessary, support the development, implementation, and maintenance of governance frameworks, policies, and processes to promote best practices within the Court.
Manage procurement activities, contracts and vendor relationships in accordance with Commonwealth requirements.
Prepare high-quality reports, briefing notes, and recommendations to inform decision-making by the Chief Justice, Court’s senior leadership and/or judges.

Project Management Expertise. Proven experience in managing complex projects, with a strong understanding of project management methodologies, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.title: E-commerce Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Waarom deze rol bij jou past

Je bouwt de analyticsbasis voor de complete e-commerce organisatie.
Je vertaalt data naar commerciële inzichten met directe businessimpact.
Je werkt samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing.

Dit ga je doen

Als E-commerce Data Analyst ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het E-commerce team kan sturen op betrouwbare inzichten en helpt collega's om betere beslissingen te nemen over onze website, app, assortiment, content en commerciële prestaties. Kortom: je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een uitdagende rol.

Je bouwt mee aan de analytics-omgeving van My Jewellery en deze geef jij zelf mede vorm. Je bouwt niet direct wat er gevraagd wordt. Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. Zo bouw je mee aan een My Jewellery dat stuurt op de juiste inzichten en leg je de basis voor de verdere groei van ons merk.

Daarnaast duik je in commerciële vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt waarom conversie verandert, welke productcategorieën het beste presteren, waar bezoekers afhaken in de funnel en welke experimenten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan omzet en marge. Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact.

In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes.

Jouw taken

Je ontwikkelt een betrouwbare analyticsomgeving en je zorgt voor eenduidige definities voor commerciële KPI's zoals conversie, omzet, marge en returns;
Je bouwt datamodellen en dashboards voor website-, app-, funnel- en productperformance;
Je analyseert conversie, funnelprestaties, productcategorieën en commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete adviezen;
Je bouwt AI coding oplossingen om je eigen werk efficiënter en effectiever te maken;
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data, onderzoekt verschillen tussen databronnen en zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten;
Je werkt als businesspartner samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing om datagedreven besluitvorming verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat jij meebrengt

Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen e-commerce, digital of product analytics;
Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en kunt zelfstandig datamodellen, analyses en dashboards ontwikkelen;
Je weet commerciële vraagstukken te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en durft stakeholders kritisch te adviseren;
Je hebt kennis van statistiek en experimentanalyse en begrijpt hoe je conversie en commerciële KPI's meet en verbetert;
Ervaring met A/B testen, conversie optimalisatie en product analytics is een sterke pré;
Ervaring met dbt, Python of web- en app-tracking is een pré.

Over My Jewellery

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sr. Business Analyst will be responsible for analyzing business processes, identifying areas for improvement, and developing solutions to enhance operational efficiency.

This role will collaborate closely with stakeholders across various departments to gather requirements, conduct data analysis, and provide actionable insights. The role involves creating detailed documentation, facilitating workshops, and ensuring alignment between business needs and technical solutions.

Operating within a global team, the Business Analyst will influence business strategies and best practices that scale across multiple regions and diverse markets. Ultimately, this position contributes to achieving business goals by optimizing processes, driving innovation, and supporting strategic decision-making.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirement Gathering & Analysis:
Conduct interviews, workshops, and surveys to gather business requirements and translate them into functional specifications. Percent of Time
30%

Process Improvement:
Analyze current business processes, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs. Percent of Time
25%

Data Analysis & Reporting:

Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions. Create comprehensive reports and dashboards. Percent of Time 20%

Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with stakeholders, including product managers, scrum master, dev lead, developers, and QA teams, to ensure alignment and successful implementation of solutions. Percent of Time 15 %

Documentation & Communication:
Develop detailed documentation, including business requirements, process flows, and user stories. Communicate findings and recommendations effectively. Percent of Time
10%

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

Product Managers to understand requirements and priorities.
Software Developers to ensure design feasibility and technical alignment.
Quality Assurance Specialists for feedback on usability and design adherence.
Marketing and Branding Teams to maintain brand consistency.
External research partners or user testing groups as needed for gathering user insights.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Relevant Experience
- 8+ years of experience as a BA in relevant domain.
Bachelor's Degree:
A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is usually required. This foundational education provides the necessary knowledge in business principles, financial analysis, and technical skills.
Master's Degree (Preferred):
A master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field can be advantageous. This advanced education can provide deeper insights into business strategy, management, and advanced analytical techniques.
Certifications:
Relevant certifications can enhance a candidate's qualifications and demonstrate expertise in business analysis. Some commonly recognized certifications include:
Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
Certification of Competency in Business Analysis (CCBA)
PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA)
Agile Analysis Certification (AAC)

TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

1.Requirements Gathering and Documentation:

Experience with requirements elicitation techniques such as interviews, workshops, and surveys.
Proficiency in creating detailed documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories

2.Business Process Modeling:

Knowledge of business process modeling techniques and tools such as BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) and UML (Unified Modeling Language).
Ability to create process flow diagrams, use case diagrams, and sequence diagrams.

3. Project Management Tools:

Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, or Microsoft Project.
Understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies and how to apply them in project management.

4.Technical Writing:

Strong technical writing skills to create clear and concise documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to write user manuals, system documentation, and training materials.
Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC):
Understanding of the various stages of the software development lifecycle and how business analysis fits into each stage.
Ability to work closely with developers and QA teams to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solutions.

5.Testing and Quality Assurance:

Familiarity with testing methodologies and tools, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Ability to create test plans, test cases, and coordinate testing activities.

6.Communication and Collaboration Tools:

Proficiency in using communication and collaboration tools such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom.
Ability to facilitate virtual meetings and workshops effectively.

Preferred:

Experience with Animal Health Diagnostics

PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Primarily a sedentary role, working at a computer for extended periods.
May occasionally require travel for user research sessions, team workshops, or conferences.
Flexible working hours to accommodate collaboration with international teams if needed.

The Senior Project Manager plays a critical leadership role in overseeing the successful delivery of complex, high-value projects for our corporate clients throughout the US and Canada. Strategy & Governance

Provide expert guidance on OT cyber risk, controls, investments, and best practices.
Lead OT cybersecurity audits and remediation activities.

IEC 62443

NIS2

Lead investigations and response activities for OT cybersecurity incidents.
Coordinate with IT Security Operations, engineering teams, and third-party providers during security events.
Monitor emerging OT threats and vulnerabilities.

Oversee OT vulnerability management, patching, and remediation programmes.
Ensure secure configuration and lifecycle management of industrial assets.
Drive continuous improvement across OT security controls and operational resilience.

Job Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Business Operations Management

VCC Lifecycle Management:
Manage daily operations of Virtual Credit Cards (VCC), covering the full lifecycle including virtual card bin application, limit configuration, activation/freezing, and expiration cancellation, to meet scenario-based needs such as airline/GDS ticket procurement, hotel pre-authorization, and bulk DMC (Destination Management Company) payments.
Client & Stakeholder Support:
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external clients to resolve card usage inquiries and transaction anomalies (e.g., failed charges, chargebacks), enhancing customer satisfaction and product stickiness.

2. Data-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

Metrics Monitoring & Reporting
: Monitor core operational metrics (card issuance rate, transaction volume/value, chargeback rate, capital occupation cost) and produce daily/weekly/monthly reports to identify business pain points and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Process Optimization:
Review VCC business processes (such as account opening approval, reconciliation & settlement, exception handling), propose optimization solutions and drive implementation — e.g., integrate with ERP systems to enable automated reconciliation, reducing 70%+ manual operations.
Travel Scenario Optimization:
Optimize VCC limit allocation, validity period settings, and merchant lock rules based on travel industry characteristics (such as urgent ticketing, fragmented high-frequency orders) to improve capital efficiency and order conversion rates.

3. Risk Management & Compliance Assurance

Regulatory & Industry Compliance:
Implement payment industry compliance requirements, ensuring operations adhere to PCI DSS data security standards, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations, and cross-border payment regulatory requirements; coordinate with internal audits and external compliance inspections.
Fraud & Risk Mitigation:
Monitor suspicious transactions and collaborate with the risk control team to develop fraud interception strategies, utilizing merchant locks, dynamic limit controls, and one-click freezing to prevent unauthorized transactions and fund risks.
Policy Adaptation:
Track changes in payment industry policies and card organization rules, promptly adjust operational strategies to ensure business compliance.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Resource Integration

Sales Enablement:
Assist with the sales team to promote VCC business, providing product training, operational guidelines, and pre-sales support to facilitate customer acquisition and conversion.
Product & Technical Alignment
: Work closely with product and engineering teams to communicate business requirements (such as system functionality enhancements and automation tool development), driving iterative upgrades of the VCC management system to improve operational efficiency.
Knowledge Sharing:
Establish internal knowledge-sharing mechanisms to disseminate VCC usage tips and scenario-based solutions to business teams, enhancing company-wide product proficiency.

Job Requirements

1. Essential Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or above, with preference given to majors in International Trade, Tourism Management, Finance, E-Commerce, or related fields.
3-5 years of operational experience in the travel industry (airline tickets/hotels/corporate travel management) or cross-border payment/VCC business operations; candidates familiar with GDS systems, airline settlement processes, or corporate travel management models are preferred.
Possess fundamental data analysis capabilities.

2. Core Competencies

Communication & Coordination
: Ability to efficiently liaise with multiple internal and external stakeholders (customers, banks, technology teams) and resolve cross-functional, cross-scenario collaboration challenges.
Risk Acumen
: Strong awareness of payment industry risks, with the ability to respond swiftly to transaction anomalies and regulatory shifts, balancing business growth with risk control.

Stress Tolerance & Problem-Solving
: Able to thrive in fast-paced, high-urgency travel industry environments, independently resolving card disputes, payment outages, and unexpected emergencies.
Industry Knowledge:
Deep understanding of pain points in travel-related cross-border payments (such as currency exchange costs, capital occupation, complex reconciliation); familiarity with VCC product features and application scenarios is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning and Management

Plan and schedule precast beam production, transportation, delivery, and installation.
Coordinate with design engineers to ensure shop drawings and structural requirements are properly reviewed and followed.
Monitor project progress, budgets, timelines, manpower, and resources.
Identify project risks and implement appropriate corrective actions.
Prepare progress reports, forecasts, and project updates for management and stakeholders.

Site Execution and Supervision

Supervise the installation of precast beams according to approved structural drawings, specifications, and method statements.
Manage site logistics, crane operations, lifting plans, rigging activities, and beam installation sequences.
Coordinate manpower, subcontractors, materials, machinery, and equipment.
Supervise site engineers, subcontractors, and workers to maintain safe and efficient operations.
Conduct daily site inspections and monitor workmanship, safety, and quality compliance.
Ensure site activities are completed promptly to prevent project delays or operational disruptions.

Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate closely with factory production teams, transport providers, design teams, and site installation crews.
Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, and management regarding project progress and requirements.
Resolve technical, logistical, and operational issues affecting project delivery.
Escalate critical issues to management with appropriate recommendations.

Safety, Environmental and Regulatory Compliance

Enforce lifting safety procedures and applicable occupational health and safety requirements.
Conduct risk assessments for the handling, storage, transportation, lifting, and installation of precast components.
Ensure compliance with the company’s safety, health, environmental, and quality policies.
Stop work immediately when an unsafe condition or environmental risk is identified.
Report accidents, non-compliance, spills, leaks, or environmental incidents without delay.
Maintain accurate documentation for audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance.
Participate in safety and environmental training and awareness programmes.
Perform other duties assigned by the immediate superior, manager, or Head of Department.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
At least five years of experience in precast concrete projects, covering both production and site installation.
Hands-on experience with cranes, lifting plans, rigging activities, and precast installation sequencing.
Recognized safety management certification, such as CIDB or an equivalent qualification, is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

Strong knowledge of precast concrete production, transportation, handling, storage, and installation methods.
Good understanding of lifting equipment, rigging safety, crane operations, and site logistics.
Ability to read and interpret structural drawings, shop drawings, specifications, and method statements.
Strong project-management, leadership, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency in project-management tools and reporting systems.
Strong commitment to safety, quality, environmental compliance, and timely project delivery.

Key Authority

The Project cum Site Manager is authorized to:
Make operational decisions within the approved project scope, budget, and timeline.
Deploy manpower, subcontractors, materials, machinery, and equipment.
Approve site activities and work methods within the designated authority.
Enforce contractual, safety, environmental, and quality requirements.
Coordinate directly with clients, consultants, contractors, and management.
Stop work when unsafe conditions or environmental risks are identified.
Report incidents and non-compliance and initiate immediate corrective action.

new_jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Position:
Deployment Strategist

Location:
Boston, NYC, Washington DC (On-Site)

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how organizations engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and business development is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm’s AI brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Big data, meets CRM, meets AI. Our mission is simple: deliver the right capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Deployment Strategists are the tip of the spear at Pryzm: the people who sit at the intersection of software, strategy, and mission. This is not a traditional implementation role. You will embed directly with our customers in the national security and federal technology space, learn their hardest problems, and build the workflows, analyses, and operational capabilities that transform how they work.

You will work alongside engineers and GTM teams to shape the roadmap, represent the customer's voice inside Pryzm, and ensure that our platform delivers measurable impact in the field. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build trust with operators and executives alike, and are driven by outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Embed with customers to understand their workflows, priorities, and decision-making processes from the inside out
Design and deploy tailored workflows and analytical tools using the Pryzm platform to solve real operational problems
Translate ambiguous mission requirements into clear product configurations, data integrations, and actionable insights
Build and maintain trusted relationships with end users, program managers, and senior leaders at customer organizations
Partner with Pryzm’s engineering teams to communicate what’s working, what’s missing, and what matters most
Drive adoption and capability expansion within existing accounts, identifying new use cases and stakeholders
Develop training materials, playbooks, and documentation that scale your impact beyond direct engagement
Support business development by participating in demos, capability briefings, and proposal efforts

What We’re Looking For

2–5 years of experience in a high-impact, customer-facing role, either or already as a Deployment Strategist or Forward Deployed Engineer, or elsewhere, such as within consulting, federal contracting, SaaS implementation, or a hybrid.
Demonstrated ability to work directly with operators and decision-makers in government or national security environments
Strong analytical instincts: comfortable with data, able to structure complex problems, and fast at learning new tools
A builder’s mindset: you don’t wait to be told what to do; you identify the gap and close it
Outstanding communication skills with an ability to translate technical concepts for a variety of audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments
Experience with government procurement, capture management, or the federal technology ecosystem is a strong plus.
Bonus: if you are technical and can write code too!

Qualifications

Located in or willing to relocate to New York, Washington DC, or Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply
Willingness for regular customer travel

Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents
Relocation assistance available

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

new_jobs.title: Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About this role
We are building an evaluation benchmark for frontier AI browsing agents. Your job is to design research problems that a state-of-the-art AI cannot solve, even with full web access and multiple attempts. This is not a subject matter expert role, nor is it a content-writing role. It is investigative research.
You will start from a verifiable fact, work backwards to construct a question that makes that fact extremely hard to locate, and then prove your work with a complete, auditable evidence trail.
What You Will Produce

A natural-language research question with a short, stable, objectively verifiable answer
Clues, each independently checkable, spanning multiple fact types - including dates, people, places, organisations, works, events, records, and quantities - with specific constraints
A validation record showing the obvious searches you ran and the results they returned

Minimum Qualifications

Demonstrated open-web research ability, including locating primary records and navigating government and institutional databases, archives, registries, and PDF documents
Precision with sourcing. You cite exact pages, tables, and sections—not just homepages
Comfort researching unfamiliar subjects from scratch
Native or near-native written English
High tolerance for structured documentation. The evidence trail is the majority of the work
Experience with LLM evaluation, red-teaming, or benchmark construction
Experience in one or more of the following domains:

Reference librarianship, archival research, or special collections
Investigative journalism or professional fact-checking
OSINT, due diligence, KYC, or investigative research
Patent, prior-art, or legal-discovery search
Genealogy and records research
Competitive quizzing or puzzle-hunt construction

Nice to Have

Familiarity with JSON and structured data delivery formats

new_jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

The Strategic Non‑Kinetic Effects Mission Division is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst with deep, cross-disciplinary expertise in networking, intelligence, and cybersecurity to design and deliver mission-critical solutions to the nation’s most complex challenges.

Roles & Responsibilities:

The Department is currently seeking a senior-career cybersecurity professional to contribute individual technical expertise and support to a complex work program in support of critical national security objectives.

Responsibilities include:

Evaluating existing methodologies and developing recommendations for improved processes, tools, analytics, and infrastructure
Identifying and leveraging capabilities from across MITRE that enable the sponsor to measurably increase mission impact
Supporting intelligence collection operations by partnering closely with Sponsor leaders to apply human and technological capabilities that enable successful operational/mission outcomes
Conveying technical, analytic, and organizational findings, recommendations, and approaches to senior decision makers and mission partners.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Ability to work with others to solve challenging technical problems.
Ability to think critically, work in group settings, and be proactive in pursuing research and problem solving.
Experience with analyzing raw threat intelligence from one or more collection disciplines (ex. SIGINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, etc.) in support of operations and/or analysis.
Deep understanding of computer networks and the OSI model, spanning hardware, software, and networking components, including how data flows and is secured across all layers.
Experience with C5ISR-T analysis. Requires current, expert-level knowledge of C4 architectures relevant to adversary analysis.
Analytical experience related to technical subjects including telecommunications and network engineering.
Experience in all-source intelligence, threat hunting, vulnerability analysis, network reverse engineering and network reconnaissance.
Familiarity with intelligence community organizational and governance structures, and/or requirements processes.
Experience with intelligence community analytic and requirements tools.
Must have an active Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI w/Poly U.S. Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position has an on-site requirement of 5 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

Intelligence community acquisition, planning, programming, budgeting and execution experience.
Familiarity with the intent, capability and operations of top tier nation-station adversary threat groups targeting operational technology in critical infrastructure, space, or weapon systems.

Top Secret/SCI

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret/SCI/Polygraph

new_jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Overview

If you've spent time studying or working outside Japan and you're ready to put that global perspective to work, this role was built for you. Japan's IT services market is one of the most complex and distinctive in the world — and IDC needs analysts who can read it from the inside while connecting it to what's happening globally. That combination is rare, and it's exactly what makes this role compelling.

About The Role

This is an opportunity to shape how the world understands Japan's IT services market — and to do it from Tokyo, at the center of one of Asia-Pacific's most dynamic technology ecosystems.

As a Research Analyst on IDC Japan's Services team, you will lead original research on Japan's IT services landscape, with a particular focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and domestic local vendors that define much of the market's character. You will contribute to two flagship IDC programs — the Japan Services CIS program and the Worldwide Semiannual Services Tracker — and collaborate closely with IDC's global and Asia-Pacific analyst network.

This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need.

What You’ll Do

Research & Analysis

Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players
Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers
Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis
Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services

Client Engagement & Business Development

Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance
Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services
Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends
Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers

Global Collaboration

Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership
Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments

What You Bring

We’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles:

IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market
Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions
Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles

Skills & Qualifications

Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan
English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan
Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word
Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team)
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.
A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

MITRE is seeking an experienced technical professional to join our Digital Investigations Department in support of a high-impact sponsor mission in the McLean, Virginia area.

Our department transforms digital data into actionable understanding by combining technical analysis, investigative tradecraft, software development, data analytics, and mission context. Our work spans digital evidence and forensics, digital intelligence and OSINT, investigative analytics, target and activity analysis, operational investigations, and the development of new investigative tools and capabilities.

This position requires a strong Python developer who can work directly with sponsor personnel to understand mission problems, develop and evolve technical solutions, and provide technical leadership to other members of the team. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between hands-on development, technical problem solving, solution design, and direct sponsor interaction.

This is an on-site position supporting a sponsor location in the McLean, VA area
. Regular presence at the sponsor site is required.

Roles & Responsibilities:

In this role, the selected candidate will:

Lead Technical Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications, analytical tools, automation, and data-processing capabilities supporting digital investigations and related mission needs.
Set Technical Direction: Translate complex or ambiguous sponsor problems into technical approaches, make architecture and implementation decisions, and help establish the direction of work performed by other team members.
Remain Hands-On: Personally develop and review production-quality Python code while contributing to troubleshooting, debugging, integration, testing, and deployment activities.
Solve Complex Technical Problems: Analyze difficult technical and mission challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and apply sound engineering judgment to develop practical and innovative approaches.
Work Directly with Sponsors: Build a strong understanding of sponsor workflows, priorities, constraints, and operational needs and use that understanding to shape technical solutions.
Guide and Elevate the Team: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to more junior staff, conduct code and design reviews, share technical knowledge, and help improve the quality and effectiveness of the team's work.
Build Sustainable Capability: Develop reusable tools, libraries, workflows, documentation, and engineering practices that improve work beyond an individual task or project.
Connect Across Disciplines: Collaborate with investigators, analysts, data scientists, engineers, and other technical experts to integrate capabilities and solve multidisciplinary problems.
Communicate Technical Concepts: Explain complex technical issues, design decisions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Evaluate Technologies and Approaches: Assess existing and emerging software, data sources, platforms, and analytical techniques and identify opportunities to improve investigative capabilities and mission outcomes.

Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance, mentorship, or review of work performed by other engineers or analysts.
Experience translating user or mission needs into technical requirements and working solutions.
Experience developing software that interacts with, processes, transforms, or analyzes complex datasets.

What The Role Is

MED is building its data and analytics capability, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. The Data Analyst will turn MED's operational, programme and policy questions into clear, reliable insights that support decision-making across the division. The officer will work with structured and unstructured data, develop dashboards and analytical products, support programme evaluation, and help MED team members use data more effectively. This role focuses on collecting, analysing and communicating data — it is distinct from a Business Analyst role.

What You Will Be Working On

The officer should focus on areas 1 to 4, with areas 5 and 6 pursued where capacity allows. Area 7 applies across all areas.

1. Data quality and documentation — Review, clean and document MED's operational datasets. Develop data dictionaries, validation rules and methodology notes so the data is reliable and easy for others to maintain.

2. Management dashboards and reporting — Work with MED team members to improve existing Tableau and Excel dashboards, and develop additional dashboards and reports where needed. Present findings as concise narratives with clear recommendations.

3. Programme evaluation — Using MOF's programme evaluation template as the framework, work with MED’s data team to analyse whether the MEP is achieving its intended outcomes and prepare the required reports and submissions for management and stakeholders.

4. Operational and thematic analysis — Identify trends, patterns, anomalies and risks in MEP operations. Conduct root-cause analysis of complaints, feedback and case records, and write up findings as clear analytical briefs.

5. Unstructured data analysis — Apply text analytics or AI-assisted methods to case notes, complaints and other documents to surface insights not captured in structured data.

6. AI-enabled analytics — Develop small-scale proof-of-concepts for AI or automation in MED's analytics work, with appropriate human oversight and governance.

7. Stakeholder engagement and capability building — Help MED teams frame analytical problems, advise on metrics and methods, and provide hands-on guidance to team members developing dashboards and analytical tools.

What We Are Looking For

Qualifications in data analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, public policy, social sciences or a related discipline, with relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, programme evaluation or operations analytics.
Proficiency in Excel and Tableau or equivalent is expected. Experience with SQL, Python or R, and familiarity with text analytics, NLP or generative AI would be an advantage.
Experience with public-sector operations or case-management data is useful but not essential.

Competencies:

[Data quality and collection] Cleans, validates and documents data; designs repeatable collection approaches.

[Analysis and modelling] Examines patterns and relationships; applies suitable quantitative methods with clear assumptions.

[Unstructured data and AI] Applies text analytics or AI methods responsibly, with human oversight and attention to risk.

[Charts and dashboards] Designs clear visualisations that support monitoring and decisions.

[Data storytelling] Communicates findings in plain language tailored to the audience.

[Stakeholder engagement] Frames analytical questions with users and supports appropriate interpretation of findings.

Key deliverables:

Management dashboards and recurring reports covering MED's priority indicators, including improvements to existing Tableau and Excel dashboards
Programme evaluation analysis supporting MED's MOF reporting commitment
Cleaned, documented datasets with data dictionaries and methodology notes to support handover and continued use after the contract ends
Thematic and trend analyses of complaints, surveys and case records, written up as analytical briefs with findings, implications and recommended actions
(Stretch) Validated AI-assisted workflows for document extraction or classification

This 11-month contract is intended to meet MED's immediate analytics and programme evaluation needs. The officer should be able to contribute with limited lead time and deliver usable outputs, documentation and knowledge transfer within the contract period. Appointment level and any applicable skills allowance remain subject to HR's assessment.

The National Project Manager plays a critical role in supporting the strategic and operational priorities of the Federal Court.

This position leads a team responsible for managing projects that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the Court’s judicial caseload and its chambers and registry operations which support the judicial work of the Court, while also overseeing governance frameworks and providing high-level executive coordination.

The role works closely with the Chambers of the Chief Justice to deliver outcomes aligned with the Court’s objectives. The role requires strong project management skills, leadership abilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to engage with senior stakeholders including judges.

Duties

Co-ordinate and assist in managing existing and new projects, including judge-led projects, that support the Court’s strategic and operational goals, ensuring timely delivery, effective implementation, resource management, and stakeholder engagement.
Coordinate and develop project plans and other project documentation, including scope, timelines, risk assessments, and reporting frameworks.
Lead and manage project staff, providing oversight over their work and ensuring they are appropriately trained and resourced to effectively complete tasks.
Ensure adequate and timely consultation with all external and internal stakeholders for any project.
Coordinate the preparation of reports, meeting agendas, minutes, follow-up actions and reports for senior leadership committees and project groups – including judge led committees and project groups.
Assist with implementation of projects and coordinating with all court staff and staff of the FCA Entity, who need to be involved in implementation of projects.
Where necessary, support the development, implementation, and maintenance of governance frameworks, policies, and processes to promote best practices within the Court.
Manage procurement activities, contracts and vendor relationships in accordance with Commonwealth requirements.
Prepare high-quality reports, briefing notes, and recommendations to inform decision-making by the Chief Justice, Court’s senior leadership and/or judges.

new_jobs.description:
Waarom deze rol bij jou past

Je bouwt de analyticsbasis voor de complete e-commerce organisatie.
Je vertaalt data naar commerciële inzichten met directe businessimpact.
Je werkt samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing.

Dit ga je doen

Als E-commerce Data Analyst ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het E-commerce team kan sturen op betrouwbare inzichten en helpt collega's om betere beslissingen te nemen over onze website, app, assortiment, content en commerciële prestaties. Kortom: je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een uitdagende rol.

Je bouwt mee aan de analytics-omgeving van My Jewellery en deze geef jij zelf mede vorm. Je bouwt niet direct wat er gevraagd wordt. Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. Zo bouw je mee aan een My Jewellery dat stuurt op de juiste inzichten en leg je de basis voor de verdere groei van ons merk.

Daarnaast duik je in commerciële vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt waarom conversie verandert, welke productcategorieën het beste presteren, waar bezoekers afhaken in de funnel en welke experimenten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan omzet en marge. Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact.

In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes.

Jouw taken

Je ontwikkelt een betrouwbare analyticsomgeving en je zorgt voor eenduidige definities voor commerciële KPI's zoals conversie, omzet, marge en returns;
Je bouwt datamodellen en dashboards voor website-, app-, funnel- en productperformance;
Je analyseert conversie, funnelprestaties, productcategorieën en commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete adviezen;
Je bouwt AI coding oplossingen om je eigen werk efficiënter en effectiever te maken;
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data, onderzoekt verschillen tussen databronnen en zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten;
Je werkt als businesspartner samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing om datagedreven besluitvorming verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat jij meebrengt

Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen e-commerce, digital of product analytics;
Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en kunt zelfstandig datamodellen, analyses en dashboards ontwikkelen;
Je weet commerciële vraagstukken te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en durft stakeholders kritisch te adviseren;
Je hebt kennis van statistiek en experimentanalyse en begrijpt hoe je conversie en commerciële KPI's meet en verbetert;
Ervaring met A/B testen, conversie optimalisatie en product analytics is een sterke pré;
Ervaring met dbt, Python of web- en app-tracking is een pré.

Over My Jewellery

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sr. Business Analyst will be responsible for analyzing business processes, identifying areas for improvement, and developing solutions to enhance operational efficiency.

This role will collaborate closely with stakeholders across various departments to gather requirements, conduct data analysis, and provide actionable insights. The role involves creating detailed documentation, facilitating workshops, and ensuring alignment between business needs and technical solutions.

Operating within a global team, the Business Analyst will influence business strategies and best practices that scale across multiple regions and diverse markets. Ultimately, this position contributes to achieving business goals by optimizing processes, driving innovation, and supporting strategic decision-making.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirement Gathering & Analysis:

30%

Process Improvement:

25%

Data Analysis & Reporting:

Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions. Create comprehensive reports and dashboards. Percent of Time 20%

Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with stakeholders, including product managers, scrum master, dev lead, developers, and QA teams, to ensure alignment and successful implementation of solutions. Percent of Time 15 %

10%

Product Managers to understand requirements and priorities.
Software Developers to ensure design feasibility and technical alignment.

Marketing and Branding Teams to maintain brand consistency.
External research partners or user testing groups as needed for gathering user insights.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Relevant Experience
- 8+ years of experience as a BA in relevant domain.
Bachelor's Degree:
A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is usually required. This foundational education provides the necessary knowledge in business principles, financial analysis, and technical skills.
Master's Degree (Preferred):
A master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field can be advantageous. This advanced education can provide deeper insights into business strategy, management, and advanced analytical techniques.
Certifications:
Relevant certifications can enhance a candidate's qualifications and demonstrate expertise in business analysis. Some commonly recognized certifications include:
Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
Certification of Competency in Business Analysis (CCBA)
PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA)

TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

1.Requirements Gathering and Documentation:

Experience with requirements elicitation techniques such as interviews, workshops, and surveys.

2.Business Process Modeling:

Knowledge of business process modeling techniques and tools such as BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) and UML (Unified Modeling Language).
Ability to create process flow diagrams, use case diagrams, and sequence diagrams.

3. Project Management Tools:

Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, or Microsoft Project.
Understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies and how to apply them in project management.

4.Technical Writing:

Strong technical writing skills to create clear and concise documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to write user manuals, system documentation, and training materials.

Understanding of the various stages of the software development lifecycle and how business analysis fits into each stage.

5.Testing and Quality Assurance:

Familiarity with testing methodologies and tools, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Ability to create test plans, test cases, and coordinate testing activities.

6.Communication and Collaboration Tools:

Proficiency in using communication and collaboration tools such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom.
Ability to facilitate virtual meetings and workshops effectively.

Preferred:

Experience with Animal Health Diagnostics

PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Primarily a sedentary role, working at a computer for extended periods.
May occasionally require travel for user research sessions, team workshops, or conferences.
Flexible working hours to accommodate collaboration with international teams if needed.
